svg.title: One million POSTs within 2 CPU and 2 GiB
svg.desc: At 10,000 concurrent requests, SwarmGo completed five of five runs with zero failures. k6 v2.3.0 with default Go memory settings exceeded the same memory limit in all five. The local target delays responses by 200 milliseconds.

g.text: SAME WORKLOAD · SAME 2 CPU / 2 GiB BUDGET
k6 v2.3.0 · default Go memory settings
Apple M4 / Docker · 1 KiB bodies · 200 ms target delay · k6 memory tuning not tested
